chapter.verse: Hih thu hangin no Gentile mite' taangin Khris Jesu' thongkiapa keimah Paul in
note' adinga kei hong kipia Pasian' hehpihna tawh kipawl innsung thuvanna vai, za khinzo dingin kong lungsimseh hi.
Tuma-in tomno khat kong gelh mah bangin mangmuhna tawh kei' tungah tua thusim hong kilang ahi hi.
Tua thu na sim uh ciangin Khris' thusim ka theihtelzia na pom thei ding uh hi.
Tua thusim pen tu hunin Kha in a siangtho sawltakte leh kamsangte' tungah a lahkhiat bang hilo-in khanghun dangte-a mihing' ta a kicite' tungah a kilakkhia hilo hi.
A thu pen Lungdamna Thu hangin Gentile mite Khris Jesu' sungah gamhluahkhawmte, pumpi khat a neikhawmte, kamciam a sangkhawmte, cih thu ahi hi.
A gamtang Pasian' vangliatna hangin ka ngah ama' deihguat thupha hehpihna tawh kizui-in kei pen hih Lungdamna Thu' ading nasem khat ka suak hi.
Mi siangtho khempeuh lakah a neu penpen ka hih sam hangin hih hehpihna kei' tungah hong kipia a, Gentile mite' kiangah tehzawhloh Khris' hauhna thu a tangko ding,
na khempeuh a piangsak Pasian' sungah khang tampi a kiseelcip thusim tawh kisai geelna hawmna thu mi khempeuh a theisak ding, ka hi hi.
Tua pen Pasian' namkim pilna thu, tu-in pawlpi tungtawnin van gamhuam sunga zaliante leh ukna thuneite theihsak nading ahi hi.
Hih pen Khris Jesu i Topa' sungah Pasian' tangtutsa tawntung ngimna dung zui ahi hi.
Khris ii ciamkipna tungtawnin ama' sungah lungsim hanna leh Pasian' kiang zuat theih nading sunglam kimuanna i nei hi.
Tua hi a, note' taangin ka thuak gimna pen note' minphatna ahih manin tua thu hangin na lungkiat loh ding uh kong thum hi.
Hih thu hangin Pa' mai-ah ka khukdin hi.
Amah pen vantung leh leitunga om innkuan kici khempeuh a kiminvawhna Pa ahi hi.
Tua hangin a cingtaak ama' minpha tawh kizui-in na sunglam mi uh ama' Kha tungtawnin vangliatna tawh hong thahatsak nading ahi zongin,
itna sungah zungthuk kha-in bulkip nei na hih mah bangun upna tungtawnin na lungsim sung uhah Khris hong teengin
mi siangtho khempeuh tawh kibangin a zaina, a sauna, a sanna, a thukna na theihtel nading uh ahi zongin,
Pasian' cingtaakna bup tawh na kidim nadingun thutheihna a khupkhelh Khris' hong itna na theih nading uh ahi zongin, thu ka ngen hi.
Tu-in eite' sunga hong gamtang vangliatna dung zui-in i ngetzah i geelzah sangin a tamzaw tham a sem thei Pasian in
a khangkhangin pawlpi sung leh Khris Jesu' sungah a tawntung a tawntungin minpha ngah ta hen. Amen.
